name: Semiconductors & AI Hardware
description: Hardware backbone of modern computing, cloud infrastructure, and AI models.
aiInsight: Highest tail-risk exposure. Taiwan foundry disruption triggers cascade shutdowns across global sectors.

name: Software & Cloud Services
description: Enterprise SaaS, hyperscale cloud, and consumer technology platforms.
aiInsight: High margins offer buffer, but cable disruptions could segment global cloud regions.

name: Energy, Oil & Gas
description: Global extraction, refining, transport, and distribution of hydrocarbons.
aiInsight: Geopolitical risk premiums account for $12–$15 of current Brent crude baseline.

name: Aerospace & Defense
description: Defense equipment, military avionics, missile defense, and naval contractors.
aiInsight: Inverse systemic hedge — heightened global risk drives multi-year defense commitments.

name: Global Banking & Financials
description: Tier-1 investment banks, payment networks, and clearing houses.
aiInsight: Capital ratios strong, but cross-border contagion remains during currency shocks.

name: Healthcare & Pharma
description: Pharmaceuticals, biotech, and healthcare services globally.
aiInsight: Defensive sector with moderate geopolitical exposure except API sourcing from Asia.

name: Industrials & Manufacturing
description: Heavy machinery, aerospace components, and industrial automation.
aiInsight: Cyclical exposure to global trade volumes and infrastructure spending.

name: Shipping & Logistics
description: Freight, parcel delivery, and maritime shipping operators.
aiInsight: Directly exposed to maritime chokepoint events — watch Hormuz and Panama Canal.

name: Automotive & EV
description: Traditional automakers and electric vehicle manufacturers.
aiInsight: Highly sensitive to chip supply and China/Taiwan manufacturing exposure.

name: Mining & Critical Materials
description: Rare earth, lithium, copper, and strategic mineral producers.
keyRisks: China export restrictions on rare earths
aiInsight: Critical to defense and EV supply chains — sanctions exposure is elevated.
